Threat_Description: Attacker replays intercepted session cookie or predicts weak token to impersonate user.
Impact_Description: Account takeover and unauthorized order or dispatch manipulation.
Preventive_Mitigation: Cryptographically random 256-bit opaque tokens stored as SHA-256 digests; strict expiry; TLS.
Detective_Control: Login anomaly logging; simultaneous session alerts.

Threat_Description: Rogue device sends fake heartbeat or telemetry by spoofing robot serial number.
Impact_Description: System assumes phantom robot is active; routes real tasks to nonexistent unit.
Preventive_Mitigation: Individual random 256-bit bearer tokens validated against cryptographic digests; deny-by-default.
Detective_Control: Mismatched IP/MAC alerts; stale heartbeat timeout triggers OFFLINE.

Threat_Description: Malicious user submits unauthorized stock adjustment altering physical balance.
Impact_Description: Falsification of inventory ledger; inventory theft or unfulfillable reservations.
Preventive_Mitigation: Strict role check (MANAGER only); positive bounds; mandatory reason code; immutable movement row.
Detective_Control: Daily inventory balance vs. movement ledger reconciliation audit.

Threat_Description: Race condition in task assignment binds two competing tasks to the same robot.
Impact_Description: Duplicate commands sent to one robot; conflicting routes and task deadlock.
Preventive_Mitigation: PostgreSQL SELECT ... FOR UPDATE row locks; partial unique index on active tasks.
Detective_Control: Transaction conflict metrics; rejection logs on duplicate active task constraint.

Threat_Description: Attacker replays valid pickup/drop acknowledgment to repeat stock movements.
Impact_Description: Double-decrementing storage inventory or inflating delivered stock count.
Preventive_Mitigation: Monotonic command sequence numbers; expected state verification; idempotent request digests.
Detective_Control: Command replay detection logs; duplicate event ID rejection.

Threat_Description: Attacker modifies warehouse grid coordinates or ignores blocked obstacle cells.
Impact_Description: Robots collide with warehouse infrastructure or another robot.
Preventive_Mitigation: Server-authoritative grid map; discrete coordinate validation; serialized occupancy checks.
Detective_Control: Spatial collision conflict logs; immediate robot emergency pause.

Threat_Description: Malicious manager denies performing stock write-off; attacker deletes audit logs.
Impact_Description: Inability to attribute fraud or establish forensic liability.
Preventive_Mitigation: Append-only database table; PostgreSQL user lacks UPDATE/DELETE permissions on audit_events.
Detective_Control: Audit log integrity hashing; centralized SIEM export.

Threat_Description: Customer manipulates order UUID in GET request to read another customer's order.
Impact_Description: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) leaking personal data and order contents.
Preventive_Mitigation: Server-side ownership predicate (customer_id == session.user_id) enforced in repository.
Detective_Control: Access denial logging on cross-tenant resource requests.

Threat_Description: Application logs or exception traces leak passwords
Impact: Credential harvesting from log management platforms.
Residual_Risk: Centralized structured JSON logger with explicit credential redaction filters.
column12: Automated secret regex scanners running in CI pipeline.

Threat_Description: Attacker floods login or order endpoint with high-volume garbage payloads.
Impact_Description: Resource exhaustion; database connection pool starvation; service outage.
Preventive_Mitigation: IP and session rate limiting; request body size limits (1MB); bounded pagination (100).
Detective_Control: HTTP 429 telemetry alerts; p95 latency threshold monitoring.

Threat_Description: Robot loses network connection mid-task; task remains locked indefinitely.
Impact_Description: Task queue blocked; customer order stalls indefinitely.
Preventive_Mitigation: Heartbeat age tracker (>30s -> OFFLINE); bounded BLOCKED state handling; operator reassignment.
Detective_Control: Operator dashboard alerts for stale devices and aged tasks.

Threat_Description: Attacker passes role='ADMIN' in profile update or self-registration payload.
Impact_Description: Mass assignment privilege escalation granting complete administrative control.
Preventive_Mitigation: Strict Pydantic request schemas; server-managed role definitions; separate admin-only API.
Detective_Control: Role modification audit events; session revocation upon role change.

Threat_Description: Customer invokes internal robot dispatch or emergency pause endpoint directly.
Impact_Description: Unauthorized control of automated physical machinery by unprivileged user.
Preventive_Mitigation: Centralized AccessPolicy enforcing OPERATOR/MANAGER role check on all dispatch endpoints.
Detective_Control: Security audit event generated on any 403 Forbidden invocation.

Threat_Description: Compromised dependency or CI runner injects unauthorized root container payload.
Residual_Risk: Non-root container UID (10001); read-only root filesystem; dependency vulnerability auditing.
column12: Kubernetes security context enforcement; image digest pinning.
